# Microsoft GitHub

> > Microsoft's open source projects and developer resources spanning AI agents, cloud infrastructure, developer tools, and enterprise platforms including AutoGen, Garnet, Prompt flow, Teams SDK, and PSRule.

This site aggregates documentation and resources for Microsoft's GitHub-hosted open source projects. It covers AI/ML frameworks (AutoGen, Prompt flow), developer SDKs (Teams, Power Platform), infrastructure tools (PSRule, Kubernetes security), research projects (Garnet, Z3), and cross-platform automation solutions.

## Key Topics

- AI Agents & Multi-Agent Frameworks
- AutoGen
- Prompt Engineering & Prompt flow
- Microsoft Teams SDK
- Azure OpenAI Integration
- Kubernetes Security
- Infrastructure as Code (IaC) Testing
- Z3 Theorem Prover
- Garnet Cache Store
- Power Platform
- Copilot Studio
- Windows Development (UWP, Win32)
- Bot Framework & Virtual Assistants
- SAP ABAP Integration
- Cross-Platform Automation

## AI & Agent Development Frameworks

- [AutoGen — Multi-Agent Framework](https://microsoft.github.io/autogen/dev/index.html): AutoGen framework with Studio, AgentChat, and Core for multi-agent systems
- [AutoGen 0.2 Getting Started](https://microsoft.github.io/autogen/0.2/docs/Getting-Started): AutoGen 0.2 quickstart with multi-agent conversations and code execution
- [Prompt flow](https://microsoft.github.io/promptflow): Prompt flow development suite for LLM app lifecycle from prototype to production
- [Prompt flow Quick Start](https://microsoft.github.io/promptflow/how-to-guides/quick-start.html): Prompt flow quickstart for creating and testing LLM flows with Prompty
- [AI Agents for Beginners Course](https://microsoft.github.io/ai-agents-for-beginners): Multi-language course teaching AI agent development fundamentals
- [UFO³ Multi-Device Orchestration](https://microsoft.github.io/UFO): UFO³ multi-device orchestration framework for cross-platform automation

## Developer SDKs & Platform Tools

- [Teams SDK](https://microsoft.github.io/teams-sdk/welcome): Teams SDK suite for building agents and apps on Microsoft Teams platform
- [Microsoft Power Platform Resources](https://microsoft.github.io/power-platform-resources): Curated Power Platform resources by Power CAT for beginners and learners
- [Windows on GitHub](https://microsoft.github.io/windows): Windows development samples and repos index for UWP, Win32, and packaging
- [AI SDK for SAP ABAP](https://microsoft.github.io/aisdkforsapabap/docs/intro): Microsoft AI SDK enabling Azure OpenAI integration for SAP ABAP developers
- [Bot Framework Solutions](https://microsoft.github.io/botframework-solutions): Bot Framework Solutions for Virtual Assistants and conversational skills

## Infrastructure & Security Tools

- [PSRule - IaC Testing Engine](https://microsoft.github.io/PSRule/v2/about): PSRule rules engine for Infrastructure as Code static analysis and testing
- [Threat Matrix for Kubernetes](https://microsoft.github.io/Threat-Matrix-for-Kubernetes/about): MITRE ATT&CK-inspired threat matrix for Kubernetes security tactics and TTPs
- [Kubernetes Security Tactics](https://microsoft.github.io/Threat-Matrix-for-Kubernetes): Kubernetes security tactics matrix covering attack techniques and mitigations
- [Garnet Cache Store](https://microsoft.github.io/garnet/docs): Garnet remote cache-store from Microsoft Research with Redis RESP protocol

## Research & Formal Methods

- [Z3 Theorem Prover Guide](https://microsoft.github.io/z3guide): Interactive online guide for Z3 theorem prover with browser execution
- [Z3 Introduction](https://microsoft.github.io/z3guide/docs/logic/intro): Z3 theorem prover introduction with SMTLIB tutorial and logical modeling
- [Z3 Datatypes](https://microsoft.github.io/z3guide/docs/theories/Datatypes): Z3 algebraic datatypes guide covering records, enums, and recursive types

## Tutorials & Learning Resources

- [Agent Instruction Lab (Beginner)](https://microsoft.github.io/copilot-camp/pages/copilot-instructions/beginner-agent): Beginner lab for improving declarative agent instructions in Copilot

## Optional

- [Bot Framework Solutions FAQ](https://microsoft.github.io/botframework-solutions/help/faq): Bot Framework Virtual Assistant FAQ covering setup, skills, and analytics
- [Presidio FAQ](https://microsoft.github.io/presidio/faq): Presidio FAQ on PII detection, anonymization, and deployment questions
- [PSRule FAQ](https://microsoft.github.io/PSRule/v2/faq): PSRule FAQ comparing to Pester and explaining IaC testing capabilities
- [UFO³ FAQ](https://microsoft.github.io/UFO/faq): UFO³ FAQ covering Galaxy, UFO², Linux agents, and troubleshooting
- [Git Credential Manager FAQ](https://microsoft.github.io/Git-Credential-Manager-for-Windows/Docs/Faq.html): Git Credential Manager troubleshooting for authentication and configuration
- [Project Ace FAQ](https://microsoft.github.io/ace/faq): Project Ace FAQ with links to GitHub issues and Twitter support
